section: Sound
roadmap: Our own WAV reader is the default everywhere, streamed sounds included
---
- Sound files (.wav) now load with our own reader, everywhere: sounds in
  the editor and in your games, and the launcher's voice clips. It is
  faster and uses less memory than the old one (about half the memory
  and up to five times faster in our tests), and it plays files the old
  one got wrong: A-law and mu-law files no longer sound like loud buzzing,
  and 64-bit float files are no longer silent. It also reads ADPCM files.
  The editor's Console says "WAV files load with our own reader" once.
- If a sound plays wrong, set OKAY_OWN_WAV=0 to go back to the old reader
  for this release, and tell us which file. Try it: examples/own_wav (open
  own_wav_test.okayscene and press Play).
- Streamed sounds (a Music Player, or an Audio Source with Stream ticked)
  now use our own reader too, so streamed A-law, mu-law and ADPCM files
  play right instead of as noise, and streaming is about two to three
  times faster. Try it: examples/own_wav/stream_test.okayscene.
